duration: Indefinite duration; subject to a 6-month probationary period from the start date.
termination_clauses: Either party may terminate with 30 days' prior written notice.
penalty_clauses: No specific penalties; end-of-service benefits apply per the UAE Federal Labour Law.
governing_law: Laws of the United Arab Emirates; jurisdiction of the Abu Dhabi Courts.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the English version shall prevail.
